gse244832.allowed_use: None while the release-fidelity gate is unresolved. If a separately named released-code comparator is approved, evaluate frozen RNA queries and donor-by-cell-state ATAC profiles only; the two aliquots remain unpaired modality sets.
gse244832.model_access: No GSE244832 rows, graph, preprocessing, labels, ATAC, fitting, early stopping, projection, or calibration before a distinct comparator and TaskSpec are approved.

gse289173.allowed_use: None under the current Monae identity. Conditional one-time RNA-only cell-state mapping is possible only after architecture fidelity is resolved, a frozen raw-RNA-to-X_pre adapter passes, and selection is relocked.
gse289173.model_access: No sealed features, labels, outcomes, graph insertion, representation learning, query fitting, head fitting, or calibration while the model is deferred.

gse296875.allowed_use: No active training while fidelity is unresolved. If activated as a renamed released-code comparator, use outer-training modality rows as unpaired sets and keep donor-held RNA and ATAC isolated for prediction and evaluation.
gse296875.model_access: A future approved run may let only outer-training donors define genes, peaks, X_pre transforms, guidance graph, model state, early stopping, heads, or calibration. Same-nucleus row order is never treated as a pairing signal by this release.

local_model_roster.common_lane_if_activated: original X_pre lane only, with frozen raw-RNA preprocessing and RNA posterior-mean embedding
local_model_roster.excluded_lane: Monae-E X_init because new held cells require transductive graph/entity embedding
local_model_roster.profile_lane_if_activated: experimental NB decode_data with frozen graph, target_libsize=1.0, no target batch, and RNA only

pairing_rules.gse244832: same_sample_different_aliquot; separate unpaired modality sets and donor-by-cell-state evaluation only
pairing_rules.gse289173: RNA_only sealed rows excluded while deferred; never add them to a Monae-E graph
pairing_rules.gse296875: same_nucleus metadata retained, but released CoVELModel modalities are trained as unpaired sets and row order supplies no objective

rules.architecture_identity: No result may be labeled Monae until a paper-faithful immutable implementation is verified. A run of the current tag requires a distinct released-code comparator name and explicit methods disclosure.
rules.biological_unit: Donors are inferential units; cells, graph nodes, predicted peaks, and seeds are not biological replicates.
rules.feature_and_graph_contract: Genes, peaks, X_pre transformations, graph vertices/edges/signs/weights, target library size, and target batch are frozen inside outer-training donors.
rules.no_false_pairing: Monae is unpaired. Never pair GSE244832 aliquots or infer same-nucleus pairing from row order; exact GSE296875 identities remain metadata/evaluator checks only.
rules.query_contract: Original-lane held queries may use a frozen raw-count-to-X_pre transform. Monae-E graph/entity fitting on held or sealed rows is prohibited.
